title: TNPSC Group 4 Post Name
qualification: For a large number of posts, including Village Administrative Officer, Junior Assistant, Bill Collector, Revenue Assistant and several other Group IV posts, the minimum general educational qualification is an SSLC / 10th Standard pass or equivalent . || Some posts require additional qualifications. Typist and Steno-Typist posts require the prescribed typewriting and/or shorthand qualification. salary: The TNPSC Group 4 Notification 2026 includes 6,574 vacancies across 46 post entries in Tamil Nadu Government departments, services, corporations and boards. Major TNPSC Group 4 jobs include Village Administrative Officer (VAO), Junior Assistant, Typist, Steno-Typist, Bill Collector, Revenue Assistant, Tax Collector, Executive Officer Grade IV, Junior Inspector, Forest Watcher and Forest Guard with Driving Licence. || The salary varies according to the post and organization. Most posts are placed under Pay Level 8 or Pay Level 10 , while some posts carry Level 3 or Level 5 pay. Certain corporation and board posts follow separate pay scales and EPF conditions.
age_limit: The age limit is calculated as on 01 July 2026 . TNPSC has prescribed separate age conditions according to the post and candidate category, so candidates should not rely on one common age limit for all Group 4 posts. || Important: The official notification contains detailed post-wise and category-wise age tables. Candidates belonging to BC, BCM, MBC/DC, SC, SC(A), ST, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen, Destitute Widow and other eligible categories should check the applicable age concession directly in Notification No. 11/2026.
application_fee: One Time Registration (OTR) is valid for five years from the date of registration. Candidates who already have a valid TNPSC OTR do not need to complete a new registration only for this examination. || The ₹100 examination fee must be paid while submitting the application unless the candidate is eligible for an exemption under the TNPSC rules. Applicable fee concessions and free chances vary by category and should be checked in the official notification. || Payment should be made through the online modes permitted by TNPSC. Candidates claiming fee exemption must ensure that they satisfy all applicable conditions.
selection_process: Selection under TNPSC Group 4 Notification 2026 is primarily based on performance in the written examination followed by verification and counselling. || Single-stage OMR-based written examination. || Preparation of merit/ranking based on the applicable examination marks. || Onscreen certificate verification for shortlisted candidates. || Physical certificate verification, where applicable. || Counselling and post allocation according to merit, reservation rules and candidate preference. || There is no interview for the general TNPSC Group 4 selection process. Certain posts, including specified technical or forest-related posts, may have additional post-specific requirements or procedures as mentioned in the official notification.
